svg.text: PCB 90 x 50 mm | all through-hole | single IDC 2x4 input from the Freezanz J3 header | MCP23017 module on a socket
INPUT - IDC 2x4, 1:1 ribbon from the Freezanz J3 header
IDC zig-zag numbering: odd pins one row, even pins the other.
SDA/SCL already have 120R in series and 3k3 pull-ups on the Freezanz board -
that is why R1/R2 stay unpopulated here.
GPIO5 and GPIO15 are strapping pins: must be HIGH at reset.
The jumper picks which 12 V feeds the board; centre pin is the output.
The TVS sits downstream of the fuse: if it fails short, F1 blows.
LOGIC RAIL AND SPARE GPIO OUTPUTS
I2C pull-ups - pads only, not fitted
XH 3p x2 - same pinout as P1/P2
R4/R5 = strapping pull-ups, pads only, not fitted:
only needed if something connected can pull the pin low
Same arrangement as P1/P2 on the Freezanz board.
A2/A1/A0 = I2C ADDRESS select, not GPIO
Place J4 at J3 + 20.32 mm in x; rotate both 270 so pin 1 ends up at the top.
M = mode select, all eight bussed to JP1:
open = normal output (as it behaves today),
closed to GND = all eight inverted at once.
470R in series = the protection that was missing.
If the yellow wire ever sees 12 V, current into the
MCP pin stays under 20 mA instead of destroying it.
In normal use it is invisible: wet, the pin sits at
0.35 V against a V_IL of 0.66 V.
The 10k pull-ups moved to the MCP side of the 470R.
The I2C ports carry 3.3 V only, no 12 V.
Port B is entirely free: 8 spare GPIO without respinning the board.
Interrupts would replace the 500 ms polling - the pins are
already on the module, use them whenever you like.
a single IDC 2x4, 1:1 from the Freezanz J3 header - no separate 12 V and I2C connectors
3-pin jumper between +12V_RAW and +12V_FILT, centre pin out - decide once the 0.2R is identified
GPIO5 and GPIO15 brought out on XH 3p with the P1/P2 pinout. Left unconnected for now
500 mA fast, Stelvio-Kontek PTF78 horizontal open holder. Only 12 V entry point
pad present, not fitted - the level sensors switch too rarely to need it
20.32 mm from the left row to the outer right row (9 pads inclusive), inner row at 17.78
A2/A1/A0 tied to GND, 0x20 fixed - no address-select header
